# Clause– Increased Leadership Expectation Security and Command personnel are held to higher expectations of roleplay than their peers. This is alongside higher expectations of adherence to corporate law, SOP, and their duties. You have more power, which also means more responsibilities.
This means that people in these roles should generally try to set an example for the station, especially regarding conduct.
## Loyalty And Escalation While Security and Command personnel are not required to display unwavering loyalty to NanoTrasen, they should never be acting directly contrary to their role without good IC justification and drastic turns of events.
Security should first and foremost focus on protecting the station crew, and enforce corporate law as a close second responsibility. This means not overescalating conflicts with potential but unconfirmed hostiles, attempting negotiations, and acting as a voice of reason rather than relying on the armory for power projection.
Command should first and foremost focus on the integrity of their department and the example they set as leaders. Departmental heads should be aware of their department, its personnel and what they are doing, and any sensitive equipment assigned to them.
Remember that your roles are, relative to that of your colleagues, prestigious and significant. Failure to act accordingly and accountably can and will result in administrative action from CentComm, or even retribution from your own crew.
